lia: dropped two tiny mocks for the streaming row — Variant Split (Stop | Regenerate) vs Variant Inline (single control -> Retry). pinging for quick take, attaching images. kevin: split buttons. less accidental regen when you mean to stop. maria: +1 split. product Q: on Stop do we keep the partial text for edits or clear it? lia: keep partial text editable. Stop = interrupt and leave content; Regenerate starts a fresh run unless the user edits first. jon: token counter: current live updates feel jumpy (every chunk). propose display "sent / limit" and smooth the left number with a short animation; also show static model limit. tasha: infra: emitting token events per chunk is costly. engineering suggestion: throttle UI updates to 200ms and only emit telemetry at chunk boundaries. lia: a11y nit — icon-only Stop is ambiguous for screen readers. instead of renaming to "Interrupt" let's keep short label but add aria-label="Stop generation" and tooltip "Esc — stop". jon: streaming container should have aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="false" so SRs don't read every chunk unless focused. snippet:
…
kevin: copy tweak — keep "Regenerate" in our taxonomy, but show hover hint: "Generate a fresh response from the same prompt." maria: prompt library drawer: push on desktop (preserves context like token meter), overlay on mobile. ensure pinned-bottom behavior during active stream if pushing. lia: decision proposal: run 2‑week A/B test (split vs inline). both variants use tokenUpdateThrottleMs=200, aria-live markup, aria-labels, and tooltips advertising Esc. capture metrics: ui.variant, action=stop|regenerate, stop_time_ms, regen_within_30s, token_update_events. helper-bot: reminder: streaming client rollout to staging Fri 11:30 PDT with canary flag. lia: thanks — i'll file the experiment ticket with mocks, acceptance criteria, and an a11y checklist. :white_check_mark:
